title: External bulk-read snapshot cursor metadata
description: Integrity-bound full-snapshot pagination metadata; v1 does not publish delta feeds. Clients accumulate ordered pages and verify the full manifest before reconciling absence.

page_item_count.description: Exact number of data items in this response page.

delivered_item_count.description: Cumulative number of ordered items delivered through this page.

item_count.description: Exact total number of ordered items in the full snapshot; never a page count.

complete.description: True only after delivered_item_count equals item_count. A complete page must have next_cursor=null.

manifest_sha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 over UTF-8 RFC 8785 canonical JSON of {manifest_version,resource,snapshot_id,as_of,high_watermark,item_count,items}, where items is the complete ordered snapshot accumulated across all pages.
